2017: The page expanded significantly in length, shifting from a brief navigation-heavy layout to a mission-driven, narrative tone focusing on sustainability, advanced technology, and partnerships.
2019: The casing of the header changed from 'About Us' to 'About us', reflecting a minor stylistic update.
2021: The text expanded massively into a comprehensive corporate overview. New themes were added including detailed sections on employees, leadership, inclusion and diversity, community care via 'Empowering Health', and a dedicated section providing support during the COVID-19 pandemic.
2022: The COVID-19 support section was dropped as the pandemic context shifted. The description of UnitedHealth Group and Optum was updated to frame the company as a 'health care and well-being company' focusing on a 'modern, high-performing health system'.
2023: The community care section was updated and reframed from 'Empowering Health' to 'Helping our communities advance health equity', emphasizing listening, learning, and partnering with communities from the ground up.
2024: The tagline changed to 'There for what matters™'. The structure was heavily rewritten with a warmer, more personal tone and redesigned headings (e.g., 'Plans of all types for people of all types', 'Simplest experience'). International care expanded to include Europe, core values added 'inclusion', and 'Diversity, equity and inclusion' replaced the previous 'Inclusion and diversity' heading.
